standard: Google Search technical requirements and durable technical SEO guidance

coverage.checklistItem: Identify the public hosts, environments, important page types, and URL changes in scope.
coverage.note: The runner records one requested and final URL; the reviewer identifies all hosts, environments, templates, and URL changes that represent the site.

coverage.checklistItem: Confirm which pages should and should not appear in search results.
coverage.note: Indexing intent is a project and content decision that must be recorded before interpreting robots and noindex signals.

coverage.checklistItem: Record access to search and analytics tools and establish a baseline before major changes.
coverage.note: The local runner does not access Search Console, analytics, server logs, rankings, or historical data.

coverage.checklistItem: Crawl representative public pages and review status codes, links, canonicals, and robots directives.
coverage.note: The profile reviews one supplied page and inventories its links; a representative multi-page crawl still requires selected URLs or an approved crawler.

coverage.checklistItem: Confirm important pages are linked, return the correct status, and contain useful content.
coverage.note: The runner checks the supplied page and its link inventory; importance, inbound discovery, content usefulness, and other pages require representative review.

coverage.checklistItem: Keep private, test, staging, search-result, and other unwanted pages out of the index.
coverage.note: The runner observes indexing directives for one public page; the reviewer must identify and test every unwanted environment and page class.

coverage.checklistItem: Use authentication or access controls for private environments, not `robots.txt` alone.
coverage.note: Private-environment protection requires hosting, identity, network, and authorized access evidence that a public page review cannot establish.

coverage.checklistItem: Provide accurate XML sitemaps and remove broken links, redirect chains, and loops.
coverage.note: The runner previews up to three same-origin sitemap files and inventories page links without fetching them; full sitemap accuracy, broken-link checking, and redirect-loop testing require a bounded crawl.

coverage.checklistItem: Use one consistent HTTPS host and redirect other versions to it.
coverage.note: The profile records the supplied URL's redirect and final host; HTTP, www, non-www, alternate-domain, and environment variants require separate authorized checks.

coverage.checklistItem: Give indexable pages a correct canonical URL and keep site signals consistent.
coverage.note: The runner checks canonical syntax and reports whether it is self-referential; correctness and consistency across internal links, redirects, sitemaps, and duplicate pages require broader evidence.

coverage.checklistItem: Control duplicate URLs created by filters, tracking parameters, print views, or alternate formats.
coverage.note: Duplicate discovery requires URL-pattern, crawl, analytics, source, and platform evidence beyond one supplied page.

coverage.checklistItem: Return real not-found responses and test old-to-new redirects when URLs change.
coverage.note: The runner records the supplied URL's status and redirect chain; representative missing URLs and the approved old-to-new migration map must be tested separately.

coverage.checklistItem: Give each important page a useful title and main heading.
coverage.note: The profile checks presence on one page and records a meta-description candidate; usefulness, uniqueness, language, and alignment with visible content require human and multi-page review.

coverage.checklistItem: Confirm important content is present in rendered HTML and works without user interaction.
coverage.note: The Playwright run records rendered text and browser errors for the initial page state; content importance, crawler rendering differences, and interaction-dependent states require further review.

coverage.checklistItem: Add valid structured data only when it matches visible page content.
coverage.note: The runner parses JSON-LD syntax and inventories Microdata and RDFa; schema validity, rich-result eligibility, and agreement with visible content require authoritative validation and human review.

coverage.checklistItem: Check language and `hreflang` relationships for localized sites.
coverage.note: The profile inventories the current page's declarations and Lighthouse syntax result; reciprocal links, canonicals, regional targeting, and the complete locale set require multi-page review.

coverage.checklistItem: Remove unintended `noindex` controls when the production site is ready.
coverage.note: For the supplied page, the runner checks rendered robots directives, the X-Robots-Tag header, robots.txt blocking observed by Lighthouse, and the resulting crawlability audit.

coverage.checklistItem: Confirm robots rules, sitemaps, canonicals, redirects, and structured data in production.
coverage.note: The profile gathers these signals for one production URL; representative templates, URL variants, sitemap contents, and structured-data meaning still require review.

coverage.checklistItem: Submit sitemaps and monitor indexing, crawl errors, traffic, and important landing pages.
coverage.note: Submission and monitoring require authorized Search Console, analytics, logging, and operational evidence.

coverage.checklistItem: Keep redirect ownership and monitoring in place after a migration.
coverage.note: Ownership, alerting, retention periods, and post-migration monitoring are operational responsibilities outside the deterministic page run.
